example.text: Illustration: If a public institution commemorates a historically under-recognised community leader, the gesture may widen public memory; its policy value would depend on whether communities also participate in decisions affecting them.

question.answer: A tribute can strengthen inclusive national memory by recognising a tribal contribution within a central democratic institution. However, it becomes substantive only when recognition is linked with community participation, rights protection and accountable delivery. The release itself evidences the tribute and stated values, not policy outcomes.
